newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks rise in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks rise in slow trade.

text.p: Most Croatian stocks rose on Friday as trade shrank due to a brokers' meeting outside the capital.
* Of 12 active issues eight rose, two fell and two were flat.
* Volume fell to 6,130 units from 24,784 and turnover shrank tenfold to 3.4 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Suncani Hvar added 3 kuna or 5.3 percent to 54, on volume of 150 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Laguna Porec lost 10 kuna (or 0.7 percent) to 1,470 with 60 shares sold.
* Most active issue Zagrebacka Banka's E-series was flat at 1,350 kuna, selling 1,271 shares. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
